references.title: DWDS: Bauer
references.supports: ²Bauer, Substantiv (Neutrum, Maskulinum), the birdcage, has no Wortzerlegung; Herkunft ahd. būr 'Wohnung, Vorratshaus' (8th c.), a Germanic noun *būra- from the root of bauen, not built from the verb

notes.rationale: The birdcage, das or der Bauer: Duden gives das, auch: der, and DWDS Neutrum, Maskulinum, in one sense, so its Core gender is mixed Masc and Neut (de/noun-gender-in-free-variation; judges agreed on #1241). DWDS gives this homograph no Wortzerlegung, so it is a bottom word with no Constituents: the Root bauer and the zero ending (ADR 0051). der Bauer, the farmer, splits bauen + -er (ADR 0050: the Reading owns the split).
